# BCGov Crow - v0.14.0

## Release type

Minor release

## Summary

Crow adds a Legacy Modernization Agent and skill to coordinate discovery,
business rules and processes, baseline tests, supported solution design,
implementation, and old/new comparison for one application or service.

## Highlights

- Trace legacy processes and external interfaces to portable tests that can
  run against both the old and replacement applications.
- Preserve system-facing contracts and existing datastores, with explicit
  approval for user-visible changes and human-run checks where automation
  cannot establish equivalence.

## Changes

- Added a modernization agent, phase-gate skill, and reusable plan template
  to the full Crow package; existing architecture, business-rules, testing,
  solution-design, and development capabilities remain the specialist owners.
- Aligned full-package and collection versions and installation examples for
  the new minor release. The focused collections do not bundle the new agent.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.14.0 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.14.0.zip --global --target copilot
```
